Production Title: THIRTEEN scene breakdown.

NEED SOMEONE TO PLAY THE MOM FOR TMRWS CLASS. URGENT. DM if available

*ISO: Melanie (30-50)

A loving but overwhelmed single mother raising her teenage daughter, Tracy, while trying to maintain her own sobriety and rebuild her life. She works as a hairdresser from home and struggles to balance being a parent, a provider, and someone who wants to be her daughter's friend. As Tracy's behavior becomes increasingly destructive, Melanie must confront how little she understands about what her daughter is experiencing. She is warm, energetic, outspoken, imperfect, and emotionally vulnerable. Beneath her casual, sometimes youthful personality is a woman who desperately wants to protect her daughter but fears losing her connection with her

**EXTRAS NEEDED – Short Film “GORGE” (SAG-AFTRA Micro-Budget Project) – Santa Ana, CA**

We’re casting **extras (diner customers)** for GORGE, a short drama directed by Dylan Boom, shooting **Monday 11/9 and Tuesday 11/10 in Santa Ana, CA**.

**Role:** Extras / diner customers, with some featured-extra moments possible. Flexible hours, a few hours on set.

**Who:** adults 18+, all looks and types.

**Compensation:** You’ll receive a copy of the final film for your reel, meal on set, and credit.

**Please note:** this is a SAG-AFTRA Micro-Budget Project, so it **does not** include SAG vouchers and doesn’t count toward union membership eligibility. All performers sign a Micro-Budget acknowledgment before working. SAG members are welcome to apply, but please keep that in mind.

**To apply:** send me a message with your name, a headshot or recent photo, and which day(s) you’re available (11/9, 11/10, or both). Location and call details will be sent once you’re booked.

Thank you!

Male actors wanted for The Crucible this coming February. Rehearsals start November 1
Calling all mature male actors in Ottawa-Gatineau. 

Rehearsals will be Sundays 1-5 and Wednesdays 6-8:30 with a break from December 16 to January 6.

We're urgently looking for a few more male actors to fill supporting and smaller roles in our community theatre production of Arthur Miller's The Crucible. 

We're looking for enthusiastic performers who enjoy bringing interesting characters to life. 

We have a large group of actors already to go. We just want to fill in these parts strongly. 

Auditions, please reach out ASAP. 

We are holding callbacks tonight, Thursday, October twenty-second, and would welcome interested actors who are available to join us. 

Can't make it tonight? 

No problem. 

We're also accepting video auditions. Video audition deadline, Friday, October 30.

If you're interested, please send me a private message as soon as possible and I'll provide the details. 

Please share this post with anyone you think might be interested. Natalie Fraser, director, The Crucible.

Connect@nataliefraser.ca

Brand Representatives Wanted – Liverpool ☕
The £1 Coffee Network | 4-Week Campaign

Staff Playbook is recruiting confident, outgoing and personable Brand Representatives to join an exciting new campaign promoting The £1 Coffee Network across Liverpool.

The campaign aims to bring more cafés, coffee shops and restaurants into the network, giving eligible customers with a Klarna account the opportunity to enjoy a barista-made coffee for just £1 at participating venues.

Your role will be to visit local cafés and restaurants, introduce the promotion to owners and managers, explain the benefits of getting involved, and help businesses sign up to the network.

📍 Campaign Details

* Location: Liverpool – field-based
* Campaign dates: Monday 2nd November – Saturday 28th November 2026
* Working pattern: 5 days per week, which may include one Saturday
* Hours: 9:00am–5:00pm
* Pay: £600 per week
* Travel allowance: £55 per week
* Mandatory training: Friday 30th October at 3:00pm

☕ Your Responsibilities

* Visit independent cafés, coffee shops and restaurants across Liverpool.
* Introduce The £1 Coffee Network and explain the promotional opportunity.
* Engage with business owners and managers to encourage participation.
* Support interested venues through the sign-up process.
* Build positive relationships with local hospitality businesses.
* Record visits, track sign-ups and provide regular campaign updates.
* Represent the campaign professionally and enthusiastically.

👋 Who We’re Looking For

* Friendly, confident and approachable individuals.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable approaching new businesses and speaking with decision-makers.
* Previous experience in field sales, business development, promotional work or customer-facing roles is desirable.
* Self-motivated, organised and able to work independently.
* Must hold a full UK driving licence and have access to a car, as the role involves travelling between venues across Liverpool.
* Available for the full four-week campaign and mandatory training.

📩 How to Apply

Interested in joining the campaign?

Please send your CV and details of your relevant experience to hello@staffplaybook.co.uk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

topComments.text: That a lot of Faffing trying to sell coffee to a business already selling coffee at their prices which is over priced. Another manoeuvre is required here to capture the coffee drinkers.

Set in the early 14th century, The Templar follows a Knight Templar forced to flee as orders are issued for the arrest of the legendary Knights Templar.
Set against the backdrop of one of the most dramatic periods in medieval history, the film explores survival, loyalty and the fate of a knight whose entire world is falling apart.
Written and directed by Vinnie Camilleri, and starring Espen Hatleskog, The Templar is an independent historical short film being produced in England.
In this latest production update, Espen shares news about the upcoming November shoot, the atmospheric locations and the dark, cinematic look we’re aiming to achieve.
With an original soundtrack in development and preparations moving forward, we’re excited to bring this story to life.
🎬 Follow the journey and support our independent film.

Discover more about the film, the cast, the production and how you can help support the project.��❤️ The Templar is dedicated to the memory of Ant “Butch” Butcher, who was due to appear in the film but sadly passed away before filming began. Although he never got the chance to bring his character to life, he will always be part of this production.��Link is on our Templar IG page

🎬 SZUKAMY AKTORÓW DO ROLEK REKLAMOWYCH!

Lubisz występować przed kamerą, masz pozytywną energię i czujesz się swobodnie podczas nagrań? Szukamy właśnie Ciebie! 🎥

Kogo szukamy?

Osób w wieku 20-60 lat

Entuzjastycznych, komunikatywnych i naturalnych przed kamerą

Osób z minimum podstawowym doświadczeniem w nagraniach, którym mogą się pochwalić

🎥 Na czym polega współpraca?

Występowanie w roli aktora w krótkich rolkach reklamowych o długości 30-40 sekund, na podstawie przygotowanych scenariuszy.

📍 Lokalizacja nagrań:

Grudziądz

Cała Polska 🇵🇱

📩 Zainteresowany/a?

Napisz do nas wiadomość prywatną, przedstaw się i prześlij krótkie nagranie lub portfolio pokazujące, jak wypadasz przed kamerą.

Czekamy na Twoje zgłoszenie! 🙌

Dziękuję, pozdrawiam.

Z powagą,
Roman Buzov.

Bo nie mam messengera

items.text: Poszukujemy jednej Pani w wieku od ok. 30 lat wzwyż, z Warszawy lub okolic, do udziału w rolkach produktowych (środki czystości). Stała współpraca, aktualnie nagrywamy 1-2 dni w miesiącu. Sesja nagraniowa zazwyczaj trwa ok 4-5 godzin. Nie wymagamy doświadczenia aktorskiego, ważne by swobodnie czuć się przed kamerą. Zainteresowane osoby proszę o komentarz tutaj lub w prywatnej wiadomości.

topComments.text: Priv, robiłam rolki m.in. dla Komputronika, Netii.

Authentische Schauspieler gesucht – Raum Frankfurt – faire Bezahlung 💚
Wir sind Glücks Krone – eine der am schnellsten wachsenden Gesundheitsmarken in Deutschland. Und wir fangen gerade erst an. 🚀

Für unsere Werbeanzeigen suchen wir Schauspielerinnen und Schauspieler, die nicht wie Schauspieler wirken. Echte Energie. Kein TV-Spot-Feeling.

Drehtage ca. 3–4 Stunden. Faire Vergütung. Wenn die Chemie stimmt, arbeiten wir langfristig zusammen.

Bewerbung dauert unter 5 Minuten 👉 https://form.typeform.com/to/ITfZoBXH

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

CASTING CALL] – CROYDON-BASED INDIE SHORT FILM: "MY SATURN"
Hi everyone! I am casting a key supporting role for an upcoming independent short film, MY SATURN, shooting this winter.

We are looking for a commanding actress for a vital supporting character. This is a highly dramatic, intense psychological piece—perfect for an actor looking for sharp, impactful showreel material without a massive time commitment.

• ROLE: Audrey

• ROLE TYPE: Supporting

• PLAYING AGE: 40 – 60

• LOCATION REQUIREMENT: Ideally South London or Croydon-based (or able to easily commute to Croydon).

• CHARACTER PROFILE: Audrey is a powerful, complex, and intensely cruel presence. She is controlling, sharp, and intimidating. We are looking for an actress who can command a room and bring a chilling, calculated edge to her scenes.

• PROJECT TYPE: Independent Short Film (No-Budget / Passion Project)

LOGISTICS:

• SHOOT DATES: Dates to be confirmed (Estimated 1-2 days this winter).

• LOCATION: Croydon, South London

• COMPENSATION: Unpaid. Travel guidance/advice can be provided, but travel expenses are not covered.

• CATERING: Hot meals and plenty of drinks are fully provided on set for the duration of the shoot.

• WHAT YOU GET: High-quality, professionally edited 4K showreel footage of your scenes provided promptly after post-production.

HOW TO APPLY:

Please email mysaturnshortfilm@gmail.com with your age, headshot, and a showreel if you have one, with the subject line "AUDREY - My Saturn Application".

Thank you so much!

We all know that Actors are extremely hard-working people, but from time to time we get to work with - or hear about - extra special professionals who are happy to go the extra mile!

This is the group for them, actors who want to help inspire a new generation; we also welcome established film makers seeking new talent, film students, and other up-and-coming film makers. Our mission is to bring the talent to those who make films. With your help we can reach 100,000 members in 2026.

Once you've joined our group, bookmark/favourite this page on your browser and check in regularly to make sure you see all the latest casting calls as soon as they are posted.

If there's an acting opportunity, paid or otherwise, you'll hopefully hear about it on here - but we would like to remind film makers, radio drama directors and others - you are reaching out to professional actors, and they will only respond if you approach them with a professional attitude. Good luck and happy acting!

When writing a post, please try to include info like: paid/unpaid, union/non-union, when, where, contact info email/phone (NOT WhatsApp!), links for more info, do you need a résumé or is it to gain experience, etc.

Posts here are vetted and have to be approved, but please do your own diligence before applying for or accepting roles. A few tips to help decide if an audition is legitimate can be found here, though this is not an exhaustive list.

https://www.backstage.com/magazine/article/acting-scam-signs-8582/

 ** If someone says they are casting and they need you to send them money for anything (plane tickets, hotel room wardrobe, or anything else), or they want to send you a check to pay for something, asking you to  give the balance to their representatives, it is always 100% a scam! 
Please be careful, if you have any doubts, don't do it! Always do your homework, talk to someone who understands the industry and NEVER give anyone money for something they are supposed to be paying you to be a part of! **

 Note that we cannot accept anonymous posts or links to private groups, all links must be publicly visible. And please feel free to report any post that doesn't meet our guidelines.

Actors!!! For the first time since 2021 - I’m getting back into the acting class room with my company on Mondays to work with both aspiring and working actors in this 8-Week Acting for the Camera Lab at Heritage College. 7:30-10:30pm

We will be workshopping new material in development, practicing auditions on camera aka self-tape magic, filming and reviewing with constructive feedback, the business of acting from the audition all the way to the red carpet, the power of creating your own work, being your best and truest self, confident on camera and working with fear, joy, love, sadness, frustration - whatever the story and the character calls for. You will have a blast identifying the little tricks that make your acting go from fake and unmoving to stunning, real and captivating! Spaces are limited. Please dm for details and to reserve your spot. ✨🎬❤️😌🎥

#actingcoach #screentraining #claudiajurt #joshuaodjick #acting

**ENGLISH-SPEAKING ACTORS / STORYTELLERS WANTED!**

We’re looking for fluent English speakers to lead evening walking tours in Kraków!

Mysterium Tours is an international company offering dark and atmospheric tours in some of Europe’s most captivating cities.

Your role will be to share Kraków’s dark stories and legends with tourists as you guide them through the Old Town.

**Working hours:** 8:00 PM – 10:00 PM
**Pay:** €50 per tour

Applicants will be asked to record a short audition video, telling a legend in a dark, atmospheric style. The script will be provided after you get in touch.

**Interested? Send me a private message for more information!**

***Do you speak German, Spanish or Italian, and would like to do this job? Get in touch with us, there might be a spot for you as well.***

Tym razem zagrałem swoją pierwszą stricte pozytywną rolę w mojej krótkiej karierze aktorskiej jako ''były drobny złodziej. Typ szczerego faceta z dzielni, który zawsze będzie lojalny wobec swoich przyjaciół.''

Your tape goes in a pile of 300.

Unless he's already met you.

At this workshop you get one-to-one time with @darrenrlgordon: Director, acting coach, and the agent behind Morello Cherry and Morello Cherry Pips. Double what you'd ever get in an audition room. His words, not ours: once he's met you, he watches your tape differently.

You'll work a real TV script and leave with a professionally recorded self tape you can actually submit.

Then an open Q&A — how he signs people, how to get an agent, how to land your first TV credit. Ask him anything.

And if you're looking for a new acting class, actors who've trained with him will tell you he's one of the best coaches in the North. Meet him in the flesh and ask to join there and then.

Booking closes this Friday. 

Book your place on the link in stories. Or in the bio. 

16+ · The Fuse, Manchester Sat 7th Nov

sharedPost.text:
Casting Call - Blackpool Region. Sept/Oct 2027.

The Tosser Squad. A Mockumentary/Parody film, set in a small call centre. 

Written by Rob Gushue and Chris Jackson. 

To most, an unwelcome disruption, but to an ever-growing group of honest, hardworking people all over the globe, it is a Way Of Life. A noble profession. And in one call center, they will do whatever it takes to Close The Sale. That is, if they can handle working together without killing each other.

Based loosely on the 2011 short series The Telemarketers

Various roles will be available.

Roles that are available (so far):

Mick - the owner of the business. He is not all together there. Forgetful, always late to the office, can't remember where he parks his car, always gets peoples names wrong. Has habit of moving people around to different desks as it "feels right", but then doesn't. 

Rachel - The Pep-Talk queen. She is the one who gives one-liner boost chats to the team. Comes out with stuff such as "This tele-calling revolution is not going to start itself, gang". When she is not giving her "words of wisdom", she is nowhere to be found. 

Karen The Crazy Cat Lady - Forever single. Likes dressing her pet in silly outfits and bring him (Mr Wobbles) to work. She thinks its cute but annoys everyone else. 

Gonzales - Originally from SE Asia. He can dance and sing like MJ, and likes to be called "The Ricky Martin" of the group. He likes hitting the sales numbers, and showing off his skills to his rival Navarro.

Navarro (Nav-Man). A Top Gun in the sales room. He is always in competition with Gonzales. Everyone thinks that he is not all there, especially his mysterious life outside of work. 

Patrick "Tiny" The Angry Accountant- He is business smart dwarf but has zero tolerance for idiots and especially Gonzales. Dresses smart, well above his pay grade. When he is on the phone to customers, he is always pleasant, but as soon as he is done with the call, his natural personalithy kicks in and starts yelling at coworkers, as he cant work out the payroll system which is an ancient as Mick. 

Barry Goc. He calls himself Goc The C***. But everyone just thinks he's a D***head. 

*Matt - almost like a Matthew McConaughey, talks slow deliberately, and you have no idea where he's going but his voice is so soothing, you just stay. Think almost like Jim Carey's impersonation of McConaughey. Likes to play Ukulele naked in his flat. Never says he gets stoned, but always talks about a "Fragrant scent around his flat" Turns out his neighbors blaze up so much he gets second hand stoning. But everyone thinks he smokes it. Fav saying "It's all the Vide man"

The Bandit - Has a habit of leaving sticky notes around the office. No one knows who he/she is. 

Bertha - Middle aged. her hobbies ar making cookies, mostly for Navarro. 

Jared (Salty Boy) - Salty Boy for a reason. His desk is cluttered with salty snacks, and everything is always controlled chaos. Lives with his mom, even though he's in his late 40's. 

Sharon (Shaz) The receptionist - Forever dateless. She messes everything up due to her lack of any coordination. Every guy who enters the office, she tries hard to get a date, but fails. She thinks that Goc is "Dreamy" but thinks he is such a A-Hole. 

Other characters will be added.

Extra Character traits
Mick:
● Squirrel On Crack. People make the joke they’re gonna get a shock collar to keep him on track in a conversation.
● You can always find him by following the trail of destruction.
● Has answered a stapler instead of cell phone before
● 80 things on the go, might get 1 or 2 done, but not the ones he needed to
● No idea how landlines work or simple stuff like transferring calls, can’t find a pen or paper to take notes or messages

Rachel/Sticky Note Bandit:
● Mick calls her by another name and has no idea who “Rachel” is. He seems to think the staff named a ghost.
● Very bad shorthand techniques, and leave them on sticky notes on Mick's door for meeting minutes (color of the notes are how important the message is). Mick takes them as threats.
● Since staff don’t pay attention to her, they have no idea about the notes when asked, nobody clues in.
● Everyone thinks what name Mick calls her is the new employee because Rachel disappears.

Karen:
● Thinks Navarro is Spanish because of his last name and asks questions to make her new Spanish bred Maine Coon feel more at home from Spain. Navarro is neither Spanish, nor does he know anything she asks him about.
● Has a pic of a cat dressed up at Christmas time with a pic of Santa. In the photo, neither the cat, nor Santa are impressed. 

Gonzales:
● Guy is great with metrics, but has no idea how to set up a presentation, or hook stuff up to his computer. Knows every detail about the internet ever.

Navarro:
● Everyone thinks he’s gay because of some very timely co-incidences I.e. Sees a person in drag walking a beautiful dog and everyone thinks he’s looking at the person in drag with the comments. He knows how to pair colors and patterns, and
always compliments a really good nail job.

Gok:
● He thinks he knows everything, and talks a big game, but he’s an idiot with his facts
● Always misquoting some fact or conversation.
● VERY OCD. Hates Jared because of the way his cubicle is, because he likes organization, and cleanliness

Bertha:
● Sees Navarro as the son she never had

Jared:
● Deliberately drive Goc nuts with a messy cubicle
● Plays on Goc’s OCD and will sneakily move things while talking to set him off afterwards.

items.text:
Hello, everyone! I’m casting for a surreal indie feature with an “early-cinema” look, with painted faces and vaudevillian/storybookish costumes…the material at turns dark, silly, poetic, musical…basically, “art film”! To get a sense of the style, you can see my work on YouTube at Candy Town Follies, and on TikTok at Candy Town Scandals.

[https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies](https://www.youtube.com/@candytownfollies)

https://www.tiktok.com/@mrdobbs

We're looking to cast a Caucasian boy, between the age of 10 and 13, to play the male lead. We’ll be shooting through to the middle of next year, in Chicago and in Elgin Illinois, with plans to get it out to the film festival circuit by the end of the year. Unfortunately, there’s no pay, as what budget we have will have to be spent on production…but we do feed everyone at the shoots, the film will be listed on IMDB, and all the actors sign contracts which entitle them to a share of the proceeds, if the movie were to make money.

If you’re a stage parent, have a son about that age, and might be interested…please contact me here or at ctfollies@gmail.com …or if you KNOW a stage parent with a son this age, please please please pass this along! Thanks so much!

items.text:
🎬 **BOOM OPERATOR WANTED – THE TEMPLAR | INDEPENDENT SHORT FILM**

We're looking for a **boom operator with some previous experience** to join us on our upcoming independent short film, *The Templar*.

📍 **Location:** Wirral / Merseyside
📅 **Filming Dates:** Friday 27th – Monday 30th November 2026

*The Templar* is a passion project being brought to life by a dedicated cast and crew, all of whom are generously giving their time on a voluntary basis.

The production budget has been invested in essential filming equipment, period costumes, props and other production requirements, meaning we're unable to offer payment for this role.

The film is also intended as a **proof of concept**. Our aim is to explore its potential, and if successful, we'd love to develop *The Templar* into a full series.

We're hoping to find someone who shares our enthusiasm for independent filmmaking and would enjoy being part of the project while gaining further on-set experience and an additional film credit.

**Some previous practical experience in boom operation or location sound recording is essential**, although we're not expecting someone with years of professional experience.

🎙️ **Sound equipment provided:**
* Boom pole with blimp windshield
* RØDE NTG3 shotgun microphone
* Zoom F6 field recorder

All the necessary sound equipment is available, although you're welcome to bring your own equipment if preferred.

We're looking for someone reliable, enthusiastic and comfortable working as part of a small, committed film crew.

🎥 **Find out more about the film:**
[https://vinniecamilleri.com/thetemplar/](https://vinniecamilleri.com/thetemplar/)

📧 **Interested or have any questions?**
Please email [info@vinniecamilleri.com](mailto:info@vinniecamilleri.com)

Please feel free to share this post with anyone who might be interested.

**The Templar – An Independent Film with Bigger Ambitions.**

items.text:
URGENT CASTING CALL | THE NEST PROJECT

MALE AND FEMALE ACTORS REQUIRED

We are urgently seeking two talented actors to join the cast of The Nest Project, an independent feature film currently approaching the final stages of production.

ROLES AVAILABLE 

Male Actor: To portray a complex, pessimistic and confrontational character with controlling, narcissistic and short-tempered tendencies. We are seeking someone capable of delivering a convincing and emotionally engaging performance.

Female Actor: To portray a mother in a supporting role.

FILMING DETAILS

Dates: Friday 30th and Saturday 31st October 2026
Location: Chester, Cheshire
Availability: Applicants must be available on both dates.

Important: We are specifically seeking actors who have not previously filmed on this production.

ABOUT THE PRODUCTION

The Nest Project is an independent passion project. This is an unpaid production with all cast and crew generously contributing their time and talent.

Successful applicants will receive an IMDb credit, valuable on-set experience and the opportunity to establish industry connections.

Following completion and post-production, we intend to submit the film to the Cannes Film Festival. 

We also have seven further film projects planned, with potential paid opportunities for cast and crew in future productions.

HOW TO APPLY - URGENT

Interested applicants should email their headshot or Spotlight profile, a brief summary of acting experience and confirmation of availability for both filming dates.

Email: info@majesticacademyofperformingarts.co.uk

We welcome applications from committed, professional and reliable actors who are enthusiastic about joining our production.

Casting by Majestic Talent Agency / Majestic Academy of Performing Arts

Please share this opportunity with any suitable actors.

Ob für Frauen oder für Männer: Du kannst deinen Anfängerkurs ganz ohne Kosten ausprobieren. Kein Abo, kein Haken. Einfach App runterladen, anmelden und lossingen! 🎤

In kurzen Videos zeige ich dir Schritt für Schritt, wie du deine Stimme richtig einsetzt – ganz in deinem Tempo, wann und wo du willst.

👉 Jetzt gratis herunterladen:
iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/sing-a-song-be-happy/id6787046663
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=de.singasongbehappy.app

Ich freue mich auf dich! 🎶

Hello All - My name is Shweta Walia and I am a Co-Producer of an upcoming South Asian Film called "The Ideal". The Ideal is being shot in multiple locations (Reston, Herndon, Ashburn) in Northern Virginia from Thursday, Nov 12th to Sunday Nov15th. We're looking for some Extras to be featured in this short film! Our team is looking for those who are curious about being in a professional film set and can wear traditional South Asian attire on set. It will only take a few hours. Food is provided. If interested, please email treelineproductions1204@gmail.com with the email subject: Interest as [ROLE] Extra - NAME, or DM us @treelineproductions!

Please see flyer for Role details, date and location of shooting.

**About the Film**

The Ideal is a short family drama about two South Asian American brothers who reunite

following the death of their mother. One brother left home to pursue professional success, while

the other stayed behind and became their mother's primary caregiver. Over the course of their

reunion, years of unspoken resentment surrounding family, sacrifice, and success begin to

surface.

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL 🎬
💥 DECEMBER 28, 1835: THE AMBUSH THAT CHANGED FLORIDA FOREVER – CASTING NOW!

​Are you ready to step back in time and bring history to life on the silver screen?

​3 Rats Entertainment is officially casting non-union Actors & Background players for DEFIANCE , a major, ground-breaking historical feature film telling the untold story of Major Francis L. Dade’s command and the powder keg that ignited the Second Seminole War.

​⚠️ WHY THIS STORY MATTERS:

On December 28, 1835, 108 U.S. soldiers marched into the dark Florida pine woods, unaware they were stepping into one of the most ruthless, devastating, and horrifying ambushes in American military history. Trapped in a brutal, desperate fight for survival, nearly the entire command was wiped out in a single morning. 

This isn’t just history, it is a harrowing, raw, and pulse-pounding saga of conflict, courage, and tragedy that changed Florida forever.

​This is Florida’s biggest epic history film, bringing an unforgettable, unvarnished, and deeply important story to the screen for the very first time!

​🔥 ROLES & REQUIREMENTS

​Roles Needed: 

​Major Dade’s U.S. Soldiers

​Actors & Background

​Age Range: Ages 20 – 35 

​Status: Paid (Non-Union)
 ✔️ 
​Target Areas: Florida locals—especially around Tampa Bay, St. Petersburg, Thonotosassa, Ocala, and surrounding communities! 

​Filming Locations: Authentic historic grounds across Florida: 

​📍 Fort King (Ocala)

​📍 Fort Foster (Hillsborough County)

​📍 Boyd Hill Nature Preserve (St. Petersburg)

​📍 Pioneer Museum (Dade City)

​🌟 WHY JOIN THIS PRODUCTION?

​Be part of a story considered the most compelling epic history film that has never been brought to the silver screen.

​Work directly alongside seasoned feature film directors, producers, and dedicated living history specialists.

​Gain invaluable set experience and be part of Florida’s cinematic history.

​📩 HOW TO APPLY ✔️ 

​We are seeking dedicated performers to be part of this legendary project! To submit, please send an email to : 3RatsEntertainment@gmail.com with the following details:

​Attn: Karolina Rybarczyk or Flor Torreance  Casting Directors 

​Photos: 1 clear recent face photo/headshot & 1 full-body photo

​Details: 

​Full Name

​Age (20–35), Height, & Weight

​City of Residence & Contact Info

​A brief note about yourself and any performance experience

​📧 Send your submission today to :  3RatsEntertainment@gmail.com and step onto the set of Florida's premier historic epic film ! 🎬  🎥 

​👉 TAG & SHARE this post with actors, reenactors, and performers in Florida who fit the age range and have what it takes!

💥 DECEMBER 28, 1835: THE AMBUSH THAT CHANGED FLORIDA FOREVER – CASTING NOW!

​Are you ready to step back in time and bring history to life on the silver screen?

​3 Rats Entertainment is officially casting non-union Actors & Background players for DEFIANCE , a major, ground-breaking historical feature film telling the untold story of Major Francis L. Dade’s command and the powder keg that ignited the Second Seminole War.

​⚠️ WHY THIS STORY MATTERS:

On December 28, 1835, 108 U.S. soldiers marched into the dark Florida pine woods, unaware they were stepping into one of the most ruthless, devastating, and horrifying ambushes in American military history. Trapped in a brutal, desperate fight for survival, nearly the entire command was wiped out in a single morning. 

This isn’t just history, it is a harrowing, raw, and pulse-pounding saga of conflict, courage, and tragedy that changed Florida forever.

# CASTING CALL – STUDENT SHORT FILM | BRISTOL

Hello everyone!

My name is Jonny, and I’m a third-year Filmmaking student at the University of the West of England (UWE Bristol). I’m currently producing a short film called *Opsequium*, and we’re looking for **two actors** to join the project!
## ABOUT THE film 

**GENRE:** Dystopian Sci-Fi, Political Drama, Psychological Thriller

**Logline:**
In the near future, a government officer is sent to retire a 'dangerous criminal' only to find an older man, a veteran with ptsd who confronts him on his morals.

**Synopsis:**

In the near future, a totalitarian government rules society. We follow a government officer on his final assignment as he prepares to leave his position. However, he is tasked with forcibly “retiring” a supposedly dangerous war veteran suffering from PTSD, forcing him to confront the reality of the system he serves.
## ROLES AVAILABLE

**1. Government Officer**
* **Playing age:** 20s–early 30s
* A government officer approaching the end of his service, faced with a morally challenging final assignment.

**2. War Veteran**
* **Playing age:** 40s–late 60s
* A war veteran suffering from PTSD who has been labelled dangerous by the government.
## ROLE DETAILS
* **Location:** Bristol and surrounding areas
* **Filming window:** 22nd–25th November 2026, with exact shoot dates to be confirmed
* **Commitment:** Voluntary roles as part of a student film production

Travel expenses to and from the filming location will be covered, and food will be provided on shooting days.
## INTERESTED?

If you’re interested in either role or would like to find out more, please email me at **[Jonnymoralee@outlook.com](mailto:Jonnymoralee@outlook.com)**.

You can also check out my YouTube channel to see some of the films I’ve worked on at UWE:

[https://www.youtube.com/@JonnyFernandezFilm](https://www.youtube.com/@JonnyFernandezFilm)

Please feel free to get in touch or share this post with anyone who might be interested!

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to hearing from you.

Jonny

🎬 CASTING | GŁÓWNA ROLA MĘSKA | WARSZAWA
Poszukujemy aktora do głównej roli w artystycznym filmie krótkometrażowym SOULVNT — Projekt 001 „Kim jesteś?”, łączącym kino, fotografię i fashion editorial.

🎭 O PROJEKCIE

Film opowiada o różnych wersjach ludzkiej tożsamości. Szukamy osoby, która potrafi wyrażać emocje poprzez mimikę, ruch i ekspresję ciała oraz chciałaby zmierzyć się z psychologicznie złożoną rolą.

📍 Lokalizacja: Warszawa

📅 Termin zdjęć: 20–22 listopada 2026 (piątek wieczorem, sobota i niedziela)

🤝 Współpraca: TFP (bez wynagrodzenia finansowego)

🎥 Co oferujemy?

Główną rolę w autorskim filmie krótkometrażowym.

Współpracę z rozbudowaną ekipą kreatywną.

Możliwość pokazania swojego warsztatu aktorskiego.

Profesjonalne materiały filmowe i fotograficzne do portfolio.

🎬 JAK WYGLĄDA CASTING?

Warunkiem udziału jest przygotowanie autorskiego nagrania aktorskiego (30–60 sekund), w którym przedstawisz własną interpretację bohatera na podstawie udostępnionych materiałów.

Same zdjęcia i portfolio nie wystarczą. Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego sprzętu ani montażu - liczą się emocje, ekspresja i kreatywność!

⏰ Deadline przesłania nagrania: piątek, 30 października 2026 r.

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Wyślij do mnie wiadomość prywatną z hasłem „KIM JESTEŚ?”.

W odpowiedzi prześlę Ci brief projektu, prezentacje z referencjami wizualnymi oraz szczegóły zadania castingowego.

Zapraszamy do udziału 🖤

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

Worry about rain, wind or cold during your acting headshot session? 

Imagine having your next session in the comfort of your own home without worrying about what the current weather might decide to do next! 🙂

I regularly travel to actors and set up my professional lighting and backdrops right in their living rooms, still creating my standard of work.

I can even bring a natural-looking backdrop to give your photos that outdoor feel - but indoors! 😉

If you don’t mind travelling, you're always welcome at my studio in Grantham, Lincolnshire.

Interested? Drop me a DM, or have a look at my work here:

# 🎬 CASTING & PRODUCTION CALL: “Dr. Jason III”

Early casting and pre-production are officially underway for **“Dr. Jason III,”** the highly anticipated sequel to the award-winning films *Dr. Jason* and *Dr. Jason II – Lights & Shadows*, streaming internationally on Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Tubi, Plex, Fawesome, and other platforms!

🎥 **Filming is scheduled for 2027 in the Stuttgart area of Germany.**
## 🎭 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are currently seeking:
* 🎬 **Actors & Actresses** — Paid opportunities
* ⭐ **Featured Extras** — Paid opportunities
* 📸 **Models** — Paid opportunities
* 🤝 **Early Contributors** — Exclusive perks and opportunities to receive Producer and Special Thanks credits

💡 **Interested in supporting the production?** An official Indiegogo campaign with exclusive perks is coming soon!

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**

Interested in joining the cast, participating in the production, or learning more about early contribution opportunities?

**Please send a private message (PM) to apply or request further information.**

🎬 **PAID CASTING CALL | DENVER, CO**

We're looking for **two adults (ages 50–70)** to portray a married couple in a professional video production for a Denver-based remodeling and construction company.

The video will follow a realistic home remodeling journey, from the initial consultation through design and construction.

**Details:**
* 💰 Pay: $30/hour per person
* 📍 Location: Denver metro area (2 filming locations per day)
* 📅 2–3 filming days (dates TBD)
* 🎥 Simple, natural scenes with little to no dialogue
* No professional acting experience required
* Real couples are encouraged to apply!

We're looking for people who are natural, relatable, comfortable on camera, and reliable enough to commit to all scheduled filming days.

**📋 Interested? Apply here:**

[https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfu2BlwaqINBXdGO8ax86cP0tpswj2flhGP1KloPHXD88E07w/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=108411361066735844477)

Please complete the application form to be considered. Selected applicants will be contacted with further details.

Feel free to share or tag someone who might be a great fit!

items.text:
We are casting for women who have lost money in an  online  financial fraud.
We are looking for people aged 18 to 35 who have been caught out by online financial fraud and are willing to tell
their story on camera. It is for a short documentary film for a bank, about how these scams can affect your life.
Shoot is half day either on 4th or 5th of November
Fee £500 paid to you , plus travel within M25 of London 
Where it will be shown Social media and across the web
We are looking for people who 
• You have lost money to online fraud. It could be a fake investment, crypto, a trading course, a
seller who never delivered, a romance scam or something else. How it happened and how much
you lost don't matter.
• We are based in and shooting in London, but happy for you to travel to us to take part.
• You are willing to talk on camera about what happened. You don't need any experience. We
want real people, not actors.
• Partners – if this has affected you both, please tell us how, we may have you both along.
This film is aimed to show how convincing these scams are.
Please fill out this form to apply: [https://form.jotform.com/262875842920365](https://form.jotform.com/262875842920365)
If you have any questions please email us hello@casscasting.com with the title ONLINE FRAUD

Fee £500 paid to you , plus travel within M25 of London 
Where it will be shown Social media and across the web
We are looking for people who 
• You have lost money to online fraud. It could be a fake investment, crypto, a trading course, a
seller who never delivered, a romance scam or something else. How it happened and how much
you lost don't matter.
• We are based in and shooting in London, but happy for you to travel to us to take part.
• You are willing to talk on camera about what happened. You don't need any experience. We
want real people, not actors.
• Partners – if this has affected you both, please tell us how, we may have you both along.
This film is aimed to show how convincing these scams are.
Please fill out this form to apply: [https://form.jotform.com/262875842920365](https://form.jotform.com/262875842920365)
If you have any questions please email us hello@casscasting.com with the title ONLINE FRAUD

Casting Call - "Saving the Timothy" - A modern drunken, drug-addled retelling of A Christmas Carol. 

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward redemption and sobriety.

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?
No previous theatre experience required — all skill levels welcome!

About the Project
Casting is open to everyone, regardless of age, race, gender, or ability.
Supportive & Peer-Led: A safe creative environment focused on personal growth, personal expression, and storytelling.
Collaborative Performance: Work together with fellow community members to bring stories to life in a live public staged reading.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026 (2:00 PM – 6:00 PM)
Rehearsals: Sundays — November 8, 15, 22, 29 (2:00 PM – 6:00 PM)
Staged Reading Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply & Join
Application Deadline: October 30, 2026
Email Submission: Submit an introduction letter, selfie/headshot & experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org
Online Application: Apply directly via Google Form Application: https://forms.gle/vHdYxLYL5A9JuGhbA

🟢 ZOSTAŃ NASZĄ KELLY 🟢

Szukamy osoby, która zagra rolę Kelly w DWÓCH spektaklach w reżyserii @just_sobczyk: 
🤖 Kelly kontra Big Tech w @teatr_zeromskiego_kielce
🙆 Kelly 🟢 w @teatr_ochoty

Musisz mieć:
🎂 18-25 lat;
👯 Doświadczenie sceniczne.

Jak wziąć udział w castingu?
📝 Wypełnij formularz dostępny w opisie instagrama @teatr_ochoty i na stronie Teatru Ochoty (przygotuj CV, informację/portfolio o swoim doświadczeniu artystycznym i zadanie castingowe ⬇️)

ZADANIE CASTINGOWE 🎭
Nagraj film (1,5 minuty), w którym jesteś Kelly podczas streamu.
Wybierz dowolną, zwyczajną czynność (coś, co mogłoby wydarzyć się w jej codziennym życiu). Możesz jeść, robić makijaż, sprzątać pokój, gotować, malować paznokcie, grać, leżeć w łóżku, przygotowywać się do wyjścia albo wybrać coś zupełnie innego.
Potraktuj nagranie jak próbę wejścia w jej sposób bycia online.
Nie musisz imitować konkretnej platformy ani tworzyć profesjonalnego streamu. 
Jakość techniczna nagrania nie ma znaczenia. Telefon wystarczy.
Możesz improwizować, możesz przygotować sobie punkt wyjścia, możesz pozwolić, żeby sytuacja rozwijała się spontanicznie. Nie szukamy gotowej interpretacji! Chcemy zobaczyć, jak badasz tę postać.

Wybrane osoby zaprosimy do II etapu, który będzie miał formę stacjonarnych warsztatów w Teatrze Ochoty w Warszawie 🥳

‼️UWAGA‼️
Prace nad spektaklem będą realizowane przede wszystkim w Teatrze im. Stefana Żeromskiego w Kielcach w terminie 12.01–13.03. Przedstawienie składa się z dwóch autonomicznych części. W założeniu aktorka wcielająca się w postać Kelly pozostaje tą samą osobą w obu częściach spektaklu – zarówno w części warszawskiej, jak i kieleckiej, odtwarzając w nich tę samą rolę.
📆 WAŻNE TERMINY
7.10 — początek przyjmowania zgłoszeń
7.10–27.10 — I etap naboru
1/2/3.12 — II etap - warsztaty teatralne w Teatrze Ochoty - i ostateczny wybór Kelly
12.01.2027 – początek prób do spektaklu (głównie w Kielcach)
13.03.2027 – kielecka premiera - KELLY KONTRA BIG TECH
19.03.2027 – warszawska premiera - KELLY 🟢

🔥 Nie czekaj, zgłoś się już dziś 🔥

Szukamy naszej filmowej babci i przytulnego domu w Warszawie!

W Impact Warsaw przygotowujemy krótki, ciepły i zabawny film w klimacie polskich świąt Bożego Narodzenia.

Szukamy starszej pani, która chciałaby zagrać babcię. Doświadczenie aktorskie nie jest konieczne. Liczą się naturalność, serdeczność i poczucie humoru.

Do zdjęć szukamy również domu lub mieszkania z ciepłym, tradycyjnym wystrojem i dekoracjami świątecznymi. Można zgłosić się do roli lub zaproponować samo miejsce.

Może Wasza mama, babcia lub sąsiadka chciałaby spróbować? Albo znacie odpowiedni dom?

Napiszcie do mnie prywatnie, chętnie opowiem więcej!

We’re looking for our film grandma and a cosy home in Warsaw!

At Impact Warsaw, we’re making a short, warm and funny film celebrating Polish Christmas.

We’re looking for an older woman who would enjoy playing Grandma. Acting experience isn’t essential. Warmth, natural expressions and a sense of humour are what matter.

We’re also looking for a home we could borrow for filming, with traditional character, a warm, cosy interior and Christmas decorations. You can help with either the role or the location.

Perhaps your mum, grandma or neighbour would enjoy being involved? Or you know a suitable home?

Please send me a private message. I’d love to tell you more!

# LGBTQ+ SUPPORTERS AND ADVOCATES 
LA BASED 

Right now, we are in pre-production on an intentional dating series called *The Booquet*, running alongside our podcast *3 Letters Deep*. Mainstream media consistently leaves Black, trans, and queer folks out of genuine romance or reduces us to a punchline, so we are producing the real thing ourselves.

We are locking in two specific lanes:
1. Singles who want actual connection. If you are Black, LGBTQ+ (specifically centering trans men and women), and done with the games on dating apps, pull up. We are actively casting intentional people ready for a real dynamic.
2. Filmmakers, editors, and crew. We are actively bringing on collaborators who care about raw, grounded storytelling and want to work on independent productions that center our people.

If you are single and looking, or if you do production work and want to link up on this shoot, drop a comment or hit my DMs directly. If you know someone who fits either lane, tag them below.

Let's talk!

🎬 WHEN IT GOES QUIET, CHECK THE CALENDAR 🎬

When you question why times are quiet and if you should stay in the game... check the calendar.

Instead, navigate what you and/or your agent can do to make the most of busy or quiet months.

That’s why I made a general UK acting industry calendar for a year. When productions are green-lit, and when it goes quiet.

Because quiet months aren’t a sign you’re failing. They’re part of the cycle. We all feel them.

📌 JAN — Reset, green-light, continuing dramas book
📌 FEB/MAR — Indie film & theatre cast
📌 APR/MAY — Day player peak
📌 JUN/JUL — Shoot season, breakdowns dip
📌 AUG — Quiet month, CDs away
📌 SEP/OCT — Second green-light, best time for agent meetings
📌 NOV — Last push for winter storylines
📌 DEC — Industry shuts down

#UKActor #BritishActor #SpotlightActor #ActorLifeUK #SupportBritishActors

Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Web Series
Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗱𝗼 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗹𝘆 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗿𝗻 𝗶𝗻 𝟱 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗺𝘆 & 𝗪𝗲𝗹𝗹𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗠𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴?
​
You start with the foundations: anatomy, ergonomics, body mechanics, and how to use your own body well while working — essential for a long and sustainable career in massage.
​
Then the practical work builds month by month, from your first 30-minute sequence to a complete 90-minute massage.
​
The aim is not simply to memorise a sequence, but to understand what you’re doing well enough that the movements become familiar, precise, and adaptable to different bodies.
​
𝗝𝗼𝗶𝗻 𝘂𝘀 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗻𝗲𝘅𝘁 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴.
Starts January 23, 2027.
Only 4 places available.

CASTING NOTICE: MOUNT VERNON’S FAVORITE SON

I am excited to announce that we are now casting day players for our independent short film, Mount Vernon's Favorite Son.

We are seeking performers of any experience who are ready to bring professionalism and energy to the set. This is an excellent opportunity for actors and non-actors looking to build their resume and collaborate with a passionate local production team based in Mount Vernon, New York.

Available Roles: Dialogue-driven rideshare/taxi passengers. For various ages and backgrounds. 

Submission Process: Please email mountvernonsfavoriteson@gmail.com with your headshot, resume, portfolio, and especially any skill sets you'd like to show off. Skills can include musical or dance, or vocational backgrounds like legal or comedic, as this can bring a unique quirk to your character and influence your performance. 

We want to work with your film character, customized to your abilities. 

Please feel free to share this opportunity with your professional network. And if you'd like to bring to a friend along with you on-set, the more the merrier. Low time commitment, footage for your reel, and a great opportunity to connect. 

We look forward to reviewing your submissions!

Hello everyone! We’re casting David and Bridget for our upcoming short film ***Boarding Home***. (ONLY LOCAL TALENT WILL BE ACCEPTED)

**Logline:** When a hopeful young woman arrives at a boarding home to visit a friend, her attempts to help the people living there catch the attention of a quiet, dejected mechanic who starts questioning why she’s really there.

We’re looking for actors who connect with the characters and are looking for something interesting to play. If David or Bridget catches your attention, we’d love to see your audition.

**Casting Details:**
**Non-Union | Unpaid | Meals Provided on Set | IMDb Credit | Professional Reel Footage**
**Shooting Date:** Saturday, November 7, 2026
**Audition Dates:** October 25–29

**Shooting Location:** Toronto, Ontario, Canada

**Interested?** Please send your headshot, resume, and demo reel to jonosei@horizondreamproductions.ca.

CASTING CALL: On-Camera Talent (Vancouver)

Your Story is casting talent for a premium training video series, shot on a curved LED wall.

1. Lead Presenter (female)

Continuity host / trainer. Straight to camera, teleprompter, polished and confident. Think MasterClass energy, not corporate video. Early 30s. Professional. Strong voice. Comfortable teaching and holding the frame.

Rate: $700/day · 2 full shoot days · includes buyout in perpetuity

2. Talk Show Co-Host (male)

Seated interview / talk-show style. Warm, sharp, natural chemistry with a co-host.

Rate: $500/day · 1 shoot day · includes buyout in perpetuity

3. Demo / Roleplay Talent (male and female)

Short on-camera demos and roleplay beats (stronger vs weaker delivery, auction-floor moments). Clear, grounded, easy to direct.

Rate: $350 half-day · includes buyout in perpetuity

Shoot: November 9 and 10, 2026

Location: Metro Vancouver

To apply, email casting@your-story.agency with a headshot, a short reel or self-tape, and which role(s) you're applying for.

items.text:
**JOHNSON PARANORMAL**

**Casting Call**

**Casting Director **– C. Patricio 

**Producers **– Ian David Nsenga, Maritama Carlson, Jeff Schellenberg

**Director **– Jeff Schellenberg

**Shoot Dates** - Nov. 19-22, 2026

**Compensation **- $200/Day

**Filming Locations** – New Westminster & Maple Ridge, B.C.

**Union Status **- Open to UBCP Union and Non-Union Performers

 

**Synopsis **– An edgy, laugh-out-loud, horror-comedy web-series about three half-brothers who open a ghost hunting start-up out of their aunt’s garage. Each episode brings a procedural-esque investigation as the crew tackles a wild new supernatural mystery.

**Tone**: Ghostbusters meets Always Sunny in Philadelphia. 

 

**CHARACTERS**

 

**FRED**** **Lead (30s/male) Fred is effortlessly handsome, incredibly chill, and a natural social butterfly. He possesses a genius-level EQ, making him instantly likable and a massive hit with the ladies—though his disorganization and inability to say no to a good time recently backfired, leaving him an ex-girlfriend turned nightmare stalker.

Brilliant, adaptable, and a victim of vanity, Fred holds a degree in chemical engineering. However, after AI took his corporate job, he decided to pivot to his childhood dream of launching his own ghost exterminating business. This unconventional career move finally allows him to monetize a deep, lifelong passion for the paranormal.

[Skills: Superb comedic timing. Strong improvisation skills are a major asset. Fred needs to feel grounded, quick on his feet, and effortlessly witty. Open to any ethnicity.]

 

**KENNY**** **Lead (30/male) Kenny is a laid-back, jack-of-all-trades with a brilliant mechanical mind and endless blue-collar connections. He’s a fisherman by trade, but with the local fishing market collapsing, he’s had to pivot to a brand-new venture: ghost exterminating.

Kenny loves a cold beer (frequently enjoyed on the job), finding clever workarounds to hard labor (which others might call laziness), and pulling a good prank. He’s a natural mentor to Delmer, but often clashes with Justin’s academic methods. He’s comfortable in his own skin, rough around the edges, and fiercely loyal.

[Skills: Excellent Physical Comedy & Distinct Character Work: We need an actor who can bring a strong, specific physical presence and comedic timing to the screen. Strong improv skills are a major asset to capture his quick-witted, easygoing banter. A natural beer belly or a burly, blue-collar physique is a huge plus. Open to any ethnicity.] 

 

**JUSTIN**** **Lead (30s/male) A brilliant but tightly wound IT whiz who walked away from tech to chase a childhood dream with his two half-brothers of opening a ghost-hunting startup. With a math PhD and software background, Justin is a true polymath, a Shakespeare nut, and a sarcastic history buff who treats life as a quest to expand his brainpower. What he has in academic genius, he completely lacks in street smarts. He’s thrilled to finally be his own boss (sort of) and step into a new chapter of personal freedom. 

[Skills: Comedic delivery. Ability to improvise is an asset. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**DELMER**** **Co-Lead (18/male) Delmer is a friendly, sweet, genuine, and wide-eyed Hutterite runaway standing on the edge of a massive new world. Built with a solid, farm-raised physicality but carrying a deep, untouched innocence, he has spent his entire life in a strict communal society. Now, he is chasing a burning yearning to experience everything he’s never seen: skyscrapers piercing the clouds, bustling shopping malls, roaring sports cars, helicopters, the vast ocean and the electric pulse of big-city nightclubs.

This role is a powerhouse opportunity for an actor to portray a profound coming-of-age journey. We are looking for someone who can beautifully balance a strong physical presence with an endearing, vulnerable naivety as Delmer steps into his chaotic, exciting next chapter. [Actor must be 18+. Preference for Caucasian ethnicity]

 

**LILY**** **Co-Lead (30/female) Lily is cute, witty, and fiercely independent. After walking away from a cushy corporate ladder and a highly judgmental family, she traded her high heels for work boots to chase her dream: running her own hobby farm.

She’s earnest, deeply down-to-earth, and entirely back-to-nature—but passion doesn't pay the tuition for her agricultural courses. Enter Johnson Paranormal. To fund her late-night studying, she’s taken a gig as the agency's newest secretary. Balancing spreadsheets, ghost sightings, and goat feed, Lily is a grounded force in a chaotic, supernatural world. [Preference for Chinese/East Asian ethnicity]

 

**Ms. GUNDERSON** (80/female) She’s your friendly neighborhood grandma. She’s sweet, independent, slightly oblivious, devoted to her baking and prized cactus, and isn't afraid to unwind with a THC gummy. But her cozy world is turned upside down by an overwhelming ghost presence that's taking over her home.

[We are looking for an actress who can balance warmth and genuine vulnerability, as she faces the supernatural and keeps an embarrassing secret. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**TONY**** **(40s/male) Tony is the ultimate contradiction: a chill, uber-organized, and ruthlessly violent drug importer who genuinely believes in giving back to his community. When he isn't managing high-stakes international logistics or handling business with cold precision, he’s passionately funding local charities and cheering on neighborhood sports teams. He runs his empire like a Fortune 500 company, but his meticulously ordered life has just been thrown into complete chaos.

An annoying, chaotic ghost has moved into his estate, wreaking absolute havoc on his sanity and his bottom line. Tony is a man used to eliminating his problems—but how do you eliminate something you can’t kill?

[Seeking an actor who can balance a grounded, dangerous intensity with a relaxed, dry charm. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**How to Apply**

Please submit your headshot, resume, and demo reel (if available) to:
**Johnsonparanormalshow@gmail.com**

*Please include the character name you are submitting for in the email subject line (e.g., "Submission: FRED - [Your Name]").*

items.text:
🎬 RUHR TAKE – Wir drehen jeden Monat einen Film in 24 Stunden

Hey, kurze Frage in die Runde:

Ich stelle im Ruhrgebiet ein festes kreatives Team zusammen, mit dem wir einmal im Monat innerhalb von 24 Stunden einen kompletten Kurzfilm entwickeln und fertigstellen.

Morgens um 8 Uhr steht nur das Genre fest. Danach entstehen gemeinsam Idee, Drehbuch, Szenenplanung und Produktion – um Mitternacht ist der Film fertig geschnitten. Eine zweite Kamera begleitet den gesamten Prozess mit Behind-the-Scenes-Aufnahmen und Zeitraffern.

Die fertigen Filme und Einblicke in die Produktion veröffentlichen wir auf Instagram, TikTok und YouTube. Auf Instagram sollen die Beiträge nach Möglichkeit als Collab-Posts mit den beteiligten Teammitgliedern erscheinen.

Gesucht werden Menschen für:

• Regie

• Kamera und BTS-Kamera

• Ton und Licht

• Schnitt und Postproduktion

• Social Media

• Schauspiel

Du musst kein Profi sein. Wichtiger sind Zuverlässigkeit, Lust aufs Filmemachen und die Bereitschaft, gemeinsam etwas aufzubauen.

Das Projekt ist aktuell unbezahlt. Dafür erhältst du verwendbares Material für dein Portfolio, Sichtbarkeit über gemeinsame Veröffentlichungen und Zugang zu einem Netzwerk, mit dem auch außerhalb des Formats weitere Projekte entstehen können.

Wenn du Interesse hast, schreib mir bitte kurz:

• welchen Bereich du übernehmen möchtest

• aus welcher Stadt du kommst

• wie deine ungefähre Verfügbarkeit aussieht

• gerne einen Link zu bisherigen Arbeiten – auch ohne Portfolio kannst du dich melden

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/keremdg_/

Das vollständige Konzept:

https://gamma.app/docs/RUHR-TAKE-Ein-Tag-Ein-Film-vatmb9rp27hgijl

Ich freue mich auf kreative Leute, die wirklich Lust haben, gemeinsam Filme zu machen.

🎬 WHEN IT GOES QUIET, CHECK THE CALENDAR 🎬

When you question why times are quiet and if you should stay in the game... check the calendar.

Instead, navigate what you and/or your agent can do to make the most of busy or quiet months.

That’s why I made a general UK acting industry calendar for a year. When productions are green-lit, and when it goes quiet.

Because quiet months aren’t a sign you’re failing. They’re part of the cycle. We all feel them.

📌 JAN — Reset, green-light, continuing dramas book
📌 FEB/MAR — Indie film & theatre cast
📌 APR/MAY — Day player peak
📌 JUN/JUL — Shoot season, breakdowns dip
📌 AUG — Quiet month, CDs away
📌 SEP/OCT — Second green-light, best time for agent meetings
📌 NOV — Last push for winter storylines
📌 DEC — Industry shuts down

#UKActor #BritishActor #SpotlightActor #ActorLifeUK #SupportBritishActors

🎬 STATYŚCI POSZUKIWANI DO TELEDYSKU ROCKOWEGO! 🎸
Szukamy mężczyzn w wieku 20-40 lat do roli rekrutów wojskowych w fabularnej części teledysku rockowego o wydźwięku antywojennym.

📍 Lokalizacja: Fort Beniaminów, okolice Warszawy
📅 Termin: 30.10
🕙 Godziny: ok. 10:00-16:00 (istnieje możliwość wcześniejszego wyjścia po wcześniejszym ustaleniu).

Kogo szukamy?

* STATYŚCI - REKRUCi WOJSKOWI: mężczyźni w wieku 20-40 lat, gotowi wcielić się w żołnierzy wykonujących ćwiczenia pod okiem surowego oficera. W planie m.in. musztra, ćwiczenia fizyczne i czołganie się w terenie.
* OFICER WOJSKOWY: mężczyzna ok. 45-55 lat, o rosłej, postawnej sylwetce i wyrazistych, surowych rysach twarzy. Mile widziana charakterystyczna prezencja i umiejętność zagrania stanowczego, bezwzględnego dowódcy.

🎥 Co oferujemy?

To niezależny projekt studencki, dlatego niestety nie możemy zagwarantować wynagrodzenia. W zamian zapewniamy:

* zwrot kosztów transportu,
* zdjęcia zza kulis (BTS), które świetnie sprawdzą się w social mediach,
* dobrą atmosferę na planie i możliwość udziału w realizacji teledysku rockowego.

Zależy nam na zaangażowanej ekipie i wspólnym stworzeniu mocnych, filmowych obrazów!

📩 Zainteresowanych prosimy o wiadomość prywatną z aktualnym zdjęciem oraz informacją o dostępności w podanym terminie.

Do zobaczenia! 🤘

✨ELVES WANTED✨
🎅 CHRISTMAS AT BEWL WATER 2026 🎅

Do you have energy, enthusiasm and a love of Christmas cheer?

We’re looking for energetic, reliable and engaging local performers to join our team of Christmas Elves for this year’s immersive Christmas Quest at Bewl Water in Lamberhurst, Kent! 🎄🌟

This is a fantastic opportunity for performers who love working with children, thrive when working in a team, and love to bring fun characters to life.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

✨ High-energy, confident performers

✨ Reliable and professional team players

✨ Great improvisers who love interacting with children

✨ Performers with high stamina and plenty of festive enthusiasm!

✨ Local performers from East Sussex, Kent & London

✨ All genders and ethnicities welcome, but you must be 18 or over

📅 PERFORMANCE DATES:

28 November

29 November

5 December

6 December

12 December

13 December

19 December

20 December

21 December

22 December

23 December

24 December

🎭 Rehearsals: 27th November 2026

⚠️ Availability: Performers MUST be available for ALL dates

💷 From £13.95 per hour

⏰ 9.5–10 hour working days

🏡 Low-cost accommodation available if required

🚗 Due to our rural location, you must be able to drive

🛡️All performers must have an Enhanced DBS check on the Update Service and Public Liability Insurance, or be willing to obtain both.

So, if you’re ready to spread some serious Christmas cheer, get stuck into an immersive experience and help create unforgettable festive memories for families, we want to hear from you! 🎅✨

📩 To apply, please send to imogen.smith@bewlwater.co.uk

• Your name & location

• A bit about you, including any specialist skills!

• A recent photo/headshot

• Showreel or Spotlight Profile

• Your availability across the dates above

We can’t wait to read all your submissions!✨

Der Kino Mittwoch auf radioYpsilon, dein Lieblingssender 

MOVIETIME KW 44/2026

MONSTERTIME ZU HALLOWEEN, EINE ÖSTERREICHISCHE LITERATURIKONE UND VIELE INTERVIEWS 

Pünktlich zum Samhain Fest starten mit OTHER MOMMY und MONSTER MIA genreübliche Filme. Ob die Titel das einhalten was diese suggerieren, erzählt Ihnen Moderatorin Sarah Fuchs. 

Sie gilt als die Schriftstellerin Österreichs nach 1945. Nöstlinger – Sowieso und überhaupt“ von Regisseurin Alexandra Schneider porträtiert die Autorin nicht nur filmisch,  wir konnten die Regisseurin vor unser Mikro bitten.

Üblicherweise ist er auf Ö3 der Muntermacher der Nation. Philipp Hansa erzählt uns über seine erste Synchronrolle und Thomas Sieben stellt höchstpersönlich im Gespräch seinen neuesten Thriller UNSAFE vor.

Natürlich darf bei uns die Musik nicht fehlen. Wir spielen die besten Musik aus den besten Filmen aller Zeiten.

Mittwoch 28.10.2026 von 18 bis 19h auf radioYpsilon 94.5 oder via Stream (http://mp3.radioypsilon.at:8000/)

**Authentische Schauspieler gesucht – Raum München – faire Bezahlung**

Wir sind **RoRoh** – natürliche Lebensmittel mit Charakter (Rohkakao, Bio-Rohriegel, Kokos & GOAT Protein). Wir suchen Gesichter, die genauso echt sind wie unsere Produkte.

Keine Hochglanz-Schauspieler, keine auswendig gelernten Zeilen – sondern Menschen mit echter Energie, die vor der Kamera einfach sie selbst bleiben.

📍 Raum München · ein Drehtag im Zeitraum 11.–13.11
⏱ ~4–6 Std. pro Dreh · faire Bezahlung · und wenn die Chemie stimmt, gerne öfter

Bewerbung in unter 5 Minuten, inkl. kurzem Selbstvideo 👇
[https://form.typeform.com/to/XB9vlK3j](https://form.typeform.com/to/XB9vlK3j)

🎬 CASTING DO SERIALU #MŁODEGLINY🎬 #bmx

Poszukujemy chłopaków w wieku 16–18 lat oraz jednej dziewczyny w wieku 16 lat-18 max lat do ról w serialu „Młode gliny”!

Szukamy osób z doświadczeniem aktorskim, które potrafią jeździć na rowerze BMX. 🚲

POSZUKUJEMY:

1. Adrian  – brat Gabrysia, napada na sklepy, jeździ na BMX.  
Liczba scen: 6
📅 Terminy: 18.11 i 23.11

2. Gabryś  – brat Adriana, zmaga się z uzależnieniem od narkotyków.  
Liczba scen: 1
📅 Termin: 18.11

3. Nikola (16 lat) – dziewczyna Gabrysia, napada na sklepy, jeździ na BMX.  
Liczba scen: 5 
📅 Terminy: 18.11 i 23.11

4. Igor –  napada na sklepy, jeździ na BMX.  
Liczba scen:5 
📅 Terminy: 19.11 i 23.11

5. Błażej  – jeden z nastolatków na skateparku, jeździ na BMX.  

Liczba scen: 1 
📅 Termin: 1 dzień na przełomie listopada i grudnia (koniec listopada / początek grudnia).

6. Nastolatek 1 – jeden z nastolatków na skateparku, jeździ na BMX.  
Liczba scen: 1
📅 Termin: 1 dzień na przełomie listopada i grudnia (koniec listopada / początek grudnia).

7. Nastolatek 2 – jeden z nastolatków na skateparku, jeździ na BMX.  
Liczba scen: 1 
📅 Termin: 1 dzień na przełomie listopada i grudnia (koniec listopada / początek grudnia).

💰 Stawka: do ustalenia.

📩 ZGŁOSZENIA:
casting@constantin-entertainment.pl

W zgłoszeniu koniecznie podaj:
• wiek,  
• opis doświadczenia aktorskiego,  
• demo aktorskie lub wizytówkę.

W tytule wpisz: BMX + rola, do której się zgłaszasz 

🎥 Masz doświadczenie aktorskie i potrafisz jeździć na BMX? Czekamy na Twoje zgłoszenie!

Do zobaczenia na planie „Młodych glin”!

🎄 POSZUKUJEMY MODELI I MODELEK DO ŚWIĄTECZNEJ SESJI ZDJĘCIOWEJ! 📸

Do realizacji klimatycznej, świątecznej sesji zdjęciowej poszukujemy osób (najchętniej rodzinki), które chciałyby stanąć przed obiektywem i wspólnie z nami stworzyć trochę świątecznej magii! ✨

🎁 Sesja realizowana jest na zasadzie barteru, czyli w zamian za udział otrzymacie profesjonalne zdjęcia, które będziecie mogli wykorzystać we własnym portfolio lub po prostu zachować na pamiątkę, do prywatnego czy rodzinnego albumu. ❤️

📍 Miejsce: Warszawa centrum 

📅 Termin: jutro, sobota, 24 października 2026 r.

🕚 Godzina: 11:00

Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego doświadczenia przed obiektywem. Zależy nam przede wszystkim na naturalności, swobodzie i dobrej energii!

📩 Jak się zgłosić?

Wyślijcie na adres: Mao16@vp.pl 

•⁠  ⁠kilka aktualnych zdjęć (nie muszą być profesjonalne),

•⁠  ⁠⁠imię,

Zgłaszajcie się jeśli jesteście dyspozycyjni w wybranym terminie ( 24.10.2026 godz. 11:00).

W tytule wiadomości wpiszcie: SESJA ŚWIĄTECZNA 2026.

Zastrzegamy sobie prawo do selekcji zgłoszeń. Odezwiemy się tylko do wybranych osób.

🎄✨ CASTING CALL – ORLANDO CHRISTMAS GALA 2026! ✨👑 

MATILDA COUTURE by MY LITTLE MATILDA invites MALE & FEMALE MODELS OF ALL AGES to join our spectacular Christmas Gala Runway Show Experience! And yes! It is going to be our magical red collection! ❤️

❤️ Date: November 14, 2026
❤️ Time: 5:00 PM
❤️ Venue: Caribe Royale Orlando, Florida
❤️ Production: Orlando International Fashion Week

✨ RUNWAY EXPERIENCE INCLUDES:
👗 Elegant designer outfit to keep after the show
📸 Professional runway photography
💄 Hair & Makeup
👑 Runway experience
📰 Feature in Matilda Model Magazine

👑 PAGEANT QUEENS & KINGS WELCOME!

Models holding pageant titles are welcome to wear their official crowns and sashes during our special carousel lineup to proudly represent their titles!

🌟 Open to beginners and experienced models, children, teens, and adults!

Garment fee applies. This is a pay-to-participate runway experience, not a paid modeling job.

🎄 Celebrate the magic of Christmas, fashion, and confidence on the runway!

📩 REGISTER HERE: LIMITED SPOTS AVAILABLE! https://pci.jotform.com/form/262608450761155

#MatildaCouture #MyLittleMatilda #OrlandoFashionWeek #Christmas #casting

# **🎬 **PAID: CASTING CALL | Vancouver Short Film *Unproven*****

Hello! We are casting two male leads!

*Unproven* is a 13–14-minute narrative short about two strangers who meet in a Vancouver laundromat and gradually enter each other’s worlds over the course of one night.

The screenplay received an Honourable Mention at the 5th Hong Kong Lesbian and Gay Film Festival Short Film Screenplay Competition. The project was also selected for the 3rd International Film Creation Camp, organized by the Asian Film Awards Academy (AFAA).

****ROLES****

• **Ishaan | Male, South Asian, 20–25**

A Pakistani international student preparing for a refugee claim interview. Fluency in English and Urdu is required.

• **Ah Long | Male, Asian, 24–30**

A Hong Kong immigrant currently living and working in Vancouver. Fluency in Cantonese and good English proficiency are required.

📍 Location: Vancouver  

📅 Tentative shoot dates: Late November 2026 (3-4 days in total)  

💰 Paid role | Non-union production | Meals and screen credits provided 

Actors of all experience levels are welcome to apply. Actors must be comfortable performing intimate scenes and physical contact. No nudity or explicit content is involved.

To apply, please email *unprovenfilm@gmail.com *with a recent headshot, contact information, availability for the shoot dates, and language proficiency. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an in person audition in early November.

Please share or repost if you know someone who will be a good fit! Thank you!

🎬 CASTING CALL — DAUGHTERS OF NOTHING 🎬
Only actors from Sheffield or Wakefield based 

As I’m coming towards the final shooting day of my film Daughters of Nothing, I’m looking for two male actors to join the cast for one final day of filming.

🎭 ROLE 1: ROOK

Rook is a powerful figure within an organised crime group and is involved in the kidnapping of a young child.

I’m looking for someone with a bold, confident and slightly intimidating presence — someone who can appear naturally suspicious or morally ambiguous without looking like a stereotypical gangster.

An authentic European accent would be preferred for this character.

🎭 ROLE 2: JULIAN

Julian is the adoptive father of young Jessica and will appear in one scene in the film.

I’m looking for a male actor approximately aged 48–60. British actors are welcome to apply.

📍 Location: Wakefield, Yorkshire

📅 Filming: One day in mid-November

⏰ Shooting time: Approximately 2–3 hours

💷 Payment: £50 total for the day’s performance

If you’re interested in either role, please get in touch with a headshot/photo, your acting experience (if applicable), and a little about yourself at:

📧 daughtersofnothing@gmail.com

I’m looking forward to hearing from you and finding the right actors for these final roles! 🎬

#CastingCall #ActorsWanted #MaleActors #YorkshireActors #Wakefield #FilmCasting #IndependentFilm #IndieFilm #DaughtersOfNothing #UKActors #ActorOpportunity #Casting
